issues.criteria_ref: timeline-three-rounds must-show (expanded last card with 在这张基础上改/换个构图), must-not-show 按钮文字被裁切; AC-7; D-78
issues.observation: At 900x700 the timeline is not scrolled to the end of the expanded last card: the 高级参数 row is cut at the timeline edge and both action buttons are below the visible area. In verify-switch-back-narrow only the top border of the buttons shows. The same states at wide width show both buttons fully.
issues.repair_suggestion: After opening a session, finishing a generation, or re-rendering, scroll the timeline so the expanded card's action row is visible (scrollIntoView block:'end' on the actions row, or scrollTop = scrollHeight when the last card is expanded); re-capture the narrow shots.

issues.criteria_ref: running-other-session precondition (会话 B 至少 1 次完成尝试) and must-show (B 的尝试; 换个构图 disabled, 在这张基础上改 enabled)
issues.observation: The highlighted session B is 新会话 · 0 次生成 and shows the 还没有图片 empty state, so the required button states and 'no A running card in B's timeline' cannot be verified. A's 生成中 badge, the status line 「甲会话的灯塔」正在生成图片 with 回到该会话, and the disabled 生成图片 are correct.
issues.repair_suggestion: Seed session B with at least one completed attempt, select it while A is running, and re-capture both viewports.

issues.criteria_ref: model-missing must-show: 头部模型状态与状态行「尚未安装图片模型，请到「资源」页下载」
issues.observation: The header subtitle correctly shows 尚未安装图片模型，请到「资源」页下载, but the status line under the composer shows 图片 MLX 运行环境缺失，请安装 .venv-image 或使用包含图片运行时的应用, identical to runtime-unavailable. 生成图片 is disabled.
issues.repair_suggestion: Keep image_runtime.present=true in the model-missing fixture so only the model is missing, and/or put the model-missing reason first in the status line; re-capture.

issues.criteria_ref: global rule (ellipsis allowed on session titles); timeline-three-rounds 会话标题 ≤24 字 + …
issues.observation: Session titles are cut after about 4-9 characters in a ~240px list item that has room for about 14 (e.g. 会失败的… for the 6-character 会失败的一张 next to the 生成中 badge). 清晨的港口， 渔船… shows a stray gap after the full-width comma.
issues.repair_suggestion: Let the title fill the row (flex:1; min-width:0) and hold back room for the 改名/删除 icons only while they are visible (hover/focus).

issues.criteria_ref: timeline-three-rounds / attempt-selected-actions must-show 大图; D-74
issues.observation: The large image in the open card renders at about 96x64, the same size as the thumbnail above it, so it looks like a duplicate thumbnail. It is fully visible and not cropped. This is likely the small mock PNG shown at its natural size, so the harness cannot prove the large-image layout.
issues.repair_suggestion: Size the open-card image to the column (width:100%; max-height:60vh; object-fit:contain) or have the mock write a PNG at the declared size; confirm large rendering in batch B.

issues.criteria_ref: attempt-cancelled must-show 卡片带「已取消」标记与说明
issues.observation: The cancelled card shows only the grey 已取消 badge and no explanation line, while the failed and interrupted cards show a reason line. Design §7.5 lets the reason text be 已取消, so this may be deliberate de-duplication.
issues.repair_suggestion: Add a muted line such as 这次生成被手动停止 (design line 81), or state in the criteria that the badge counts as the explanation.

issues.criteria_ref: global consistency; AC-7
issues.observation: While an image job is running, the header shows 媒体：空闲 · 可开下一件重活 (narrow: 可开工) and 内存里：无, which contradicts the running card. In running-other-session the header correctly shows 生成中.
issues.repair_suggestion: Refresh the header media status right after a job is submitted, or wait for the header to update before capture.

issues.repair_suggestion: Give dialog buttons a clear :focus-visible ring, or trigger keyboard focus before capture.

issues.criteria_ref: attempt-selected-actions: 必须出现「在这张基础上改」「换个构图」两个次级按钮完整可见；大图完整显示（不被裁切）；不得出现两个动作按钮被遮挡或裁切
issues.observation: After clicking attempt 1, the timeline shows only the large image; the card header is scrolled away. Neither action button is in view at either width. In narrow, the large image is also cut at the bottom by the timeline viewport. The expanded card (header + image up to 60vh + prompt + 高级参数 + actions) is taller than the timeline area at 1280×800 and 900×700, so image and actions can never be seen together.
issues.repair_suggestion: Cap the expanded image by the timeline's own height rather than 60vh (e.g. max-height: calc(timeline-height − header − actions)). Or place the two actions next to or above the large image. After selecting, scroll so the action row is in view (scrollIntoView block:'nearest' on the actions, or on the card end). Re-capture both widths.

issues.criteria_ref: timeline-three-rounds: 时间线从上到下「第 1 次」「第 2 次」「第 3 次」；第 3 次展开：大图、完整提示词、折叠的「高级参数」、两个按钮

On the expanded 第 3 次, only the top part of the large image shows; the full prompt, 高级参数 and both action buttons are below the fold at both widths. The same root cause as 001: the expanded card doesn't fit in the timeline viewport.
issues.repair_suggestion: Fix via 001's layout change so the expanded card fits. Then capture evidence that shows all three rounds plus the expanded card's actions: either a timeline that fits, or two captures (top and bottom) declared in the record.

batches.summary: All 48 screenshots opened and judged visually. No blockers: no horizontal scroll, broken or blank image frame, clipped button text, overlap, foreign pane content, or 种子 on the image page. 3 majors: (1) at narrow width the open last card's two action buttons are hidden below the composer on first view (timeline-three-rounds, verify-four-attempts, verify-switch-back); (2) running-other-session was captured with an empty session B, so the required button states cannot be checked; (3) the model-missing status line shows the runtime-missing reason. 6 minors: titles cut too short, open-card image at thumbnail size, cancelled card without an explanation line, header idle while generating, no visible dialog focus, library-after-delete shows only part of its criteria. 4 notes.

Real-model images render correctly everywhere: no blank or broken frames, no horizontal scroll, and no 种子 in the image-page main flow. Running, refine-prefill, delete-confirm, running-other-session, model-missing and after-restart persistence all pass. The batch fails on AC-7's central point, the two action buttons. The expanded attempt card (header + image up to 60vh + prompt + 高级参数 + actions) is taller than the timeline viewport at both 1280×800 and 900×700, so in attempt-selected-actions and timeline-three-rounds the actions are never visible, and in narrow the cancelled card is sliced mid-line. The cancelled card also lacks its explanation line, and the library-after-delete evidence doesn't show the post-delete session list.
